scenarios.title: Firebending adds red mana when the creature attacks and the mana lasts until end of combat

setup.notes: Fire Sages is a 2/2 with firebending 1 and the ability '{1}{R}{R}: put a +1/+1 counter on this creature'. B controls no creatures.

decisions: A attacks player B with Fire Sages; the firebending trigger goes on the stack.
Both players pass; the firebending trigger resolves, adding {R}.
B declares no blockers. In the declare blockers step A activates Fire Sages' {1}{R}{R} ability, paying with the {R} from firebending and two Mountains.
Both players pass; the ability resolves and combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: attacks
variants.expected: The firebending trigger fires and A adds {R}, which is still in A's mana pool in the declare blockers step. Fire Sages gets a +1/+1 counter and deals 3 combat damage to B (17).

variants.label: does_not_attack
variants.delta: A does not attack with Fire Sages.
variants.expected: No firebending trigger fires and no mana is added. A cannot pay {1}{R}{R} with two Mountains, so Fire Sages gets no counter and B's life stays 20.

variants.label: mana_not_used_in_combat
variants.delta: A does not spend the firebending mana during combat and tries the activation in the second main phase.
variants.expected: The firebending trigger fires and A adds {R}, but the mana empties at the end of combat. In the second main phase A cannot pay {1}{R}{R} with two Mountains, so Fire Sages gets no counter. Fire Sages deals 2 combat damage to B (18).

scenarios.title: An ability that triggers when a player firebends fires when a firebending ability that player controls resolves

setup.notes: Avatar Aang reads 'Whenever you waterbend, earthbend, firebend, or airbend, draw a card' (and transforms if you have done all four this turn). Avatar Aang does not attack.

decisions: A attacks player B with Fire Sages only; the firebending trigger goes on the stack.
B passes without responding. Both players pass; the firebending trigger resolves and Avatar Aang's trigger goes on the stack.
Both players pass; Avatar Aang's trigger resolves.

variants.label: firebending_resolves
variants.expected: The firebending ability resolves, A adds {R}, and Avatar Aang's trigger fires. A draws a card (hand 1, library 1).

variants.label: firebending_countered
variants.delta: In response to the firebending trigger, B casts Stifle, tapping Island, targeting the firebending trigger.
variants.expected: Stifle counters the firebending trigger, so A adds no {R}, and Avatar Aang's trigger does not fire. A draws no card (hand 0, library 2).

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge fires the Firebend trigger from the mana effect of the firebending ability (ManaEffect.java).
